{{Quote|Our credo is 'Service. Fealty. Fidelity.' This may be the first time you have heard it. By the time you graduate, it is one you will never forget.|[[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Holt (Fleet Admiral)|Holt]], during an Academy cadet indoctrination speech|<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Naval Academy''', originally known as the '''Republic Naval Academy''', was the primary naval academy used by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. The Academy was also known by names such as the '''Prefsbelt IV Naval Academy''', '''Prefsbelt Imperial Academy''', '''Prefsbelt Fleet Camp''', and the '''Imperial Naval College''', and though the academy's location was officially classified, it was widely known to be located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]]. Founded after the [[Pius Dea Crusades]] during [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Pers Pradeux]]'s restructuring of the Republic Navy, the academy served the Republic for thousands of years, and served its successor state, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], as one of the three premier institutions of the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] system.

==Description==
[[File:ImperialAcademy-SWEMP8.jpg|250px|left|thumb|A graduation ceremony at the Imperial Naval Academy]]
The Naval Academy on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]] was built on the hills surrounding around [[Castle Pradeux]] and the [[Twelve Mounts]]&mdash;a series of peaks named after famous [[Space warfare/Legends|naval battles]]. A lengthy passage, [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] long, ran from Castle Pradeux to the heart of the Twelve Mounts, ending at the [[Naval Crypt]] where the "Father of the Navy," [[Pers Pradeux]], was entombed. During graduation, midshipmen would walk the length of the passage in silence to the Crypt, where each would dedicate themselves to the naval service. After graduation, midshipmen recessed down the Incline of the Mounts, which was lined with monuments and historical artifacts, and were then conveyed by [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertrain]] to [[Prefsbelt Green]]. The [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhook]] over Prefsbelt Green led to [[Prefsbelt Black]], where midshipmen would receive their orders. Classrooms within the Academy often included large [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojectors]] used to display simulations and records of past battles.<ref name="Warfare" />

There was also another portion of the academy located in a barren valley that contained a central tower, at least two hangars, four barred hangars, searchlights, and a landing pad that was guarded by four turrets, with several TIEs often landing on the ground at night. At least three communication arrays and five landing pads were also in close proximity to the building, and the building was also guarded by eight sensor arrays.<ref name="Rogue Leader">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Officers from this Academy&mdash;and only this Academy&mdash;are recognized as the very best the Emperor has to command.|[[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Holt (Fleet Admiral)|Holt]]|<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook" />}}
[[File:FlightAcademy-TCGRfT.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Cadets being trained at the Imperial Naval Academy]]
Prefsbelt IV was first discovered by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] Pers Pradeux of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Pius Dea Crusades]], and he turned the world into a retreat for naval officers of the [[Renunciates]] movement. After the [[Battle of Uquine]] brought an end to [[Pius Dea]] rule of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[10,966 BBY]], Pradeux and his fellow officers rebuilt and reorganized the Republic Navy during a series of meetings on Prefsbelt, and the planet was chosen as the site of the Republic Naval Academy. Its location remained secret for more than a thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]], but even after it became known,<ref name="Warfare" /> the Academy's location remained officially need-to-know; many children from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] knew of Prefsbelt from [[Holodrama/Legends|holodramas]].<ref name="Core">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> Under the Republic, the Republic Naval Academy trained the [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]] of the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] and [[Planetary Security Forces]] for generations; [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] was one of many naval officers to come out of Prefsbelt. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] came to power in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Academy became a cornerstone of the new [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] system,<ref name="Warfare" /> with smaller [[Sector Naval Academy|Sector Naval Academies]] being modeled after the primary Naval Academy.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook" />

Prefsbelt students began with academic study and tactical simulations, and later moved on to leadership courses and active service rotations as [[Ensign/Legends|ensigns]]. Most students entered naval service after three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] at the Academy, but some students instead shifted to flight schools, and some continued their studies at the Empire's three specialized military schools, as did some graduates of the [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Imperial Army Academy]] on [[Raithal/Legends|Raithal]]. The [[Corulag Academy|Corulag Imperial Military Academy]] trained cadets from all services, putting an emphasis on active training, while [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]] focused on active training and combat simulations, serving as a think tank and testing ground for new warships and equipment. Some students also spent semesters at the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]], the training academy for the Empire's [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]]. The Academy also included an [[Officer Candidate School]], which [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was recommended for.<ref name="Warfare" />

Before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] worked as an instructor at the Academy on Prefsbelt IV, where he trained cadets including [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]], [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], and [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]], all of whom defected to become heroes of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Warfare" /> Nevertheless, Prefsbelt IV produced many notable Imperial officers such as [[T. Alvak]],<ref name="Star Wars Sourcebook" /> [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]], [[Zsinj]],<ref name="Warfare" /> and [[Evir Derricote]].<ref name="Rogue Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the Rebel Alliance, the mathematics instructor [[Greg Somax]] was an Alliance spy at the Academy, recruiting operatives from the ranks of the Imperial cadets.<ref name="Rebel">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Delak Krennel]] was an unarmed combat champion there, while his classmate [[Wynt Kepporra]] was an engineering student and a member of the [[Thespian Union]] at the Academy.<ref name="Isard">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref>

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Imperial Naval Academy was [[Mission to Prefsbelt IV|infiltrated]] by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] to retrieve the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] [[Tydirium/Legends|''Tydirium'']] after it somehow ended up back in Imperial hands.<ref name="Rogue Leader" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Naval Academy was first mentioned in the first edition of [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']], the [[October]] [[1987]] rulebook for [[West End Games]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', and its location was established in ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'' a month later. However, the [[1989]] ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'' stated that the Academy's location was unknown even to most of its students. and various subsequent sources did not always refer to the Academy's location. The contradiction was resolved with the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', which established that the Academy's location on Prefsbelt was common knowledge despite it being officially classified. The Imperial Academy system and the Prefsbelt Academy were further fleshed out in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]], resolving various contradictions about the Imperial training systems.<ref name="Fry">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/23039847571/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-7|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 7}}</ref>
